sentences.en: I perceive by your face that you have good news.
sentences.zh: 从你的脸上，我察觉到你有好消息。

sentences.en: The alert guard perceived a dim shape in the distance.
sentences.zh: 警觉的守卫在远处察觉到了一个模糊的身影。

sentences.en: The alert officer perceived a dim shape in the distance.
sentences.zh: 警觉的哨兵在远处察觉到了一个模糊的身影。
